territorial_scope.description: Applies to undertakings active to a considerable extent in markets under § 18(3a) GWB, and orders are addressed to individually designated undertakings.

summary.short: Empowers the Bundeskartellamt to designate, by order, an undertaking of overriding cross-market significance for competition, and then to prohibit listed conduct toward other firms. Designations are limited to five years; applies to firms active to a considerable extent in § 18(3a) GWB markets.
summary.long: Section 19a GWB lets the Bundeskartellamt, by order, find that an undertaking active to a considerable extent in § 18(3a) markets has overriding cross-market significance for competition, weighing market dominance, financial strength, vertical integration, access to competition-relevant data and its role in third parties' market access. The finding is limited to five years after it becomes final. Once made, the authority may prohibit the undertaking from favouring its own offers (including by pre-installation), hindering rivals, tying services, creating entry barriers through data processing, refusing interoperability or data portability, inadequately informing business partners, or demanding disproportionate advantages. Objectively justified conduct is excluded, the burden of proof lying with the undertaking. Sections 32(2)-(3), 32a and 32b apply accordingly, and a prohibition may be combined with the finding. Sections 19 and 20 are unaffected. The Federal Ministry for Economic Affairs and Energy must report to the legislature on experience four years after the provisions enter into force. The text gives no entry-into-force date.

notes: Excerpt of one section (§ 19a) from an online page; the fetched text shows no version date, retrieval date or entry-into-force date. All cross-references (§ 18 Abs. 3a, §§ 19, 20, 32, 32a, 32b) are to provisions of the GWB itself and name no other instrument, so no relation rows are coded. The enacting act is not stated in the fetched text; the registry title's reference to a GWB-Digitalisierungsgesetz is unverified and not coded. The Abs. 1 determination is discretionary (kann), and the Abs. 2 prohibitions depend on a prior Abs. 1 determination; Abs. 1 sets a five-year limit from Bestandskraft. Abs. 2 closing sentence excludes objectively justified conduct, with the burden of proof on the undertaking. Undertaking size and significance (erhebliches Umfang, überragende Bedeutung) are not quantified in the text.

Bei der Feststellung der überragenden marktübergreifenden Bedeutung eines Unternehmens für den Wettbewerb sind insbesondere zu berücksichtigen:

obligations.summary: The Bundeskartellamt may determine by order that an undertaking active to a considerable extent on markets under § 18(3a) has overriding cross-market significance for competition; the order must be time-limited to five years after it becomes final (Bestandskraft), and the authority may consider the listed factors (dominance, financial resources, vertical integration, access to competition-relevant data, access of third parties to markets).
obligations.conditional_on: Applies to the determination order under § 19a(1) Satz 1; time limit runs from the order becoming final (Bestandskraft)

evidence.quote: Das Bundeskartellamt kann durch Verfügung feststellen

obligations.summary: An undertaking determined under § 19a(1) may be prohibited by the Bundeskartellamt from the conduct listed in § 19a(2) Nr. 1 to 7, including preferential treatment of own offers when mediating market access, obstructing other undertakings' market activity, tying or conditioning use of services, using competition-relevant data to raise entry barriers, refusing interoperability or data portability, insufficient information to other undertakings, and demanding disproportionate advantages; the prohibition does not apply where the conduct is objectively justified, with the burden of proof on the undertaking; the prohibition order may be combined with the determination under § 19a(1).
obligations.conditional_on: Requires a prior determination under § 19a(1) and a prohibition order by the Bundeskartellamt; does not apply where the conduct is objectively justified (sachlich gerechtfertigt)

obligations.summary: The Federal Ministry for Economic Affairs and Energy (Bundesministerium für Wirtschaft und Energie) reports to the legislative bodies on experience with the provision after four years from entry into force of paragraphs 1 and 2.
obligations.conditional_on: Four years after entry into force (Inkrafttreten) of the regulations in § 19a(1) and (2); the text gives no calendar date

thresholds.note: § 19a sets no numerical cutoff that changes legal treatment. 'in erheblichem Umfang' is qualitative. The five-year period for the designation order in Abs. 1 Satz 2 is a duration of the order, not a threshold, and the four-year reporting period in Abs. 4 is a procedural time limit.
